title: Chapter 52 Capturing Players
content:
Chapter 52 Capturing Players

In the blink of an eye, Wang Shuo led his cavalry team into the territory of a player named Qiao Zhongsheng.

At this moment, Qiao Zhongsheng was looking around in panic in the territory. Although he had expected Wang Shuo's sudden intrusion, he was still a little scared to encounter a player so soon.

Especially when he saw that there were several people on the other side, and they were riding war horses, and their sophisticated equipment emitted a cold light.

He was immediately scared to death!

Wang Shuo checked his attributes, which were mediocre, level 3, and could not pose a threat to Wang Shuo at all.

With a charge, Wang Shuo shot directly through the opponent's chest. Suddenly, a "-55" damage appeared on the opponent's head. His blood volume at the moment was only more than 400.

Qiao Zhongsheng still wanted to resist, but in the face of absolute strength, everything was in vain.

After a few rounds, he was subdued by Wang Shuo.

"Don't kill me, don't kill me, I don't want to die!" Qiao Zhongsheng immediately begged for mercy.

Wang Shuo did not kill him, mainly because of Chang Gui's suggestion.

All the supplies on Qiao Zhongsheng were confiscated, and then handed over to Gong Ping for custody.

Wang Shuo consciously took the lead and charged forward.

He mainly wanted to train himself, the courage to fight the enemy on the battlefield, and hone his combat skills.

Before coming to this world, Wang Shuo was still a person who had never killed a chicken. If he did not practice how to kill people on the battlefield, how could he kill people in the future!

Kindness does not command the army!

Starting from the first person he killed, Ichiro Fukuda, Wang Shuo has experienced the baptism of blood.

Facing the enemy, you must have a heart of stone.

At present, most of the players have not reacted yet, and this is the best time to take the initiative.

"In troubled times, you must not be merciful." Wang Shuo agreed with Chang Gui's words.

Soon Wang Shuo took action again.

Looking around, there were about a dozen shelters. Wang Shuo picked the nearest one and set off again with his subordinates.

There was almost no suspense in the battle at this moment. As the first in the small area before, Wang Shuo's combat strength was undoubtedly very advanced, and ordinary players basically had no resistance.

After capturing 5 players in a row, Wang Shuo finally met his first opponent.

Guliji: Level 7, Occupation: Assassin.

This was the basic information Wang Shuo had detected when he first started fighting.

Seeing that she was outnumbered, Guliji missed a single blow and chose to escape directly.

On the way here, Wang Shuo had already found a destroyed shelter, which should have been done by Guliji.

After seeing her strength, Wang Shuo finally met a decent opponent and was determined to compete with her openly.

At this moment, a system announcement suddenly sounded.

[Congratulations to player Yang Zeshan, the first to build a village, reward: reputation +100]

"So fast?" Wang Shuo asked in surprise, "It seems that we need to speed up."

He looked up and saw the direction where Guliji fled, and said sternly: "Chase."

Guliji wanted to escape to the Watang Mountain to avoid Wang Shuo's cavalry, but she didn't expect Wang Shuo's reaction so quickly that she was surrounded in just a few minutes.

"Why do you have to be so aggressive, why don't we say goodbye and don't interfere with each other from now on." Seeing that there was no hope of breaking through, Guliji looked at Wang Shuo and others nervously, with a panic expression on her face.

She couldn't understand why this person had formed a cavalry team at the beginning.

Wang Shuo was unmoved by her words.

Weakness is the original sin!

"I can give you a chance, a chance to fight me fairly. As long as you beat me, I will let you go. If you lose, you will be my subordinate." Wang Shuo said confidently.

When Wang Shuo proposed this bet, Guliji agreed readily.

At this moment, she had her own little plan in mind. If she won, she could kill the opponent directly and then run away.

If she lost, she would pretend to surrender first, and then find a chance to escape or assassinate her. It would be a win no matter how you looked at it.

Wang Shuo was absolutely confident. Whether in terms of equipment attributes or levels, he crushed his opponent.

If she could hurt herself in the competition, it would be her ability.

The competition officially began.

Wang Shuo got off the horse, holding the gun with both hands, with the gun tip facing forward, ready for battle.

Guliji was wearing tight leather armor, holding a double blade, and her eyes were sharp, giving people an extremely dangerous feeling.

Wang Shuo did not take it lightly. He could despise his opponent strategically, but he could not despise his opponent tactically.

"You can attack!" Wang Shuo snorted coldly.

Guliji also kept adjusting her pace, looking for the best attack route.

Before she entered this trial game, she was a killer, proficient in various assassination methods, and good at disguise and reconnaissance.

After entering the game world, she was like a fish in water.

Survival in the wild was a piece of cake for her.

So, she quickly achieved good results and successfully entered the top 10 in her small area.

Regarding Wang Shuo's behavior of proposing a duel, she felt that her opponent was really stupid.

Soon, she found the opponent's flaw, and with a flexible move, the blade in her right hand rushed directly to Wang Shuo's lower left abdomen, while the blade in her left hand was ready to block Wang Shuo's spear.

Players like Wang Shuo who have no martial arts foundation are somewhat disadvantaged in such a battle.

However, he has been working hard to increase his combat experience, and in the process of killing the skeleton soldiers, he has also mastered some combat skills.

Seeing his opponent rushing over, he retreated instead of advancing.

The armor on his body is of gold level, enough to withstand the opponent's double blades.

Wang Shuo relied on his long weapon, and stabbed his opponent's chest directly.

Due to the setting of life value, there are few situations where one-shot kills occur, so Wang Shuo can attack boldly without worrying about killing his opponent.

The long spear and the short blade created dazzling sparks.

As soon as they fought, both of them were shocked.

"I didn't expect the opponent to be so strong."

Wang Shuo relied on his powerful attributes and excellent equipment, while Guliji relied on her flexible body movements and rich experience.

The two sides fought back and forth, and the battle gradually became stalemate.

At the same time, countless lords outside the Dahuai domain were also watching everything that happened here through the props provided by Lord Zach.

"What a wonderful battle! This kind of passionate scene always reminds people of the time when they were still a rookie."

"Yes, so many years have passed!"

"Hmph, Lord of the Earth, you are still in the mood to watch this kind of game. I believe that it won't be long before your territory will be caught in the flames of war!"

"Although I hope for peace, I and the people of my territory are not afraid of war! No matter who dares to invade my territory, I will make him regret it."

In a certain [chat channel], many lords were criticizing the players in the Dahuai District, and they would have a few quarrels from time to time.

As time passed, the battle between Wang Shuo and Guliji also came to an end.

After fighting for a long time, Guliji's physical attributes were much lower than Wang Shuo's, and her endurance was naturally not as good as Wang Shuo's.

At this moment, she was a little out of breath, and the rhythm of the battle was controlled by Wang Shuo.

Seeing that she was at a disadvantage, she sold a flaw to lure Wang Shuo to attack.

Wang Shuo saw an opportunity and attacked Guliji with the intention of exchanging injuries for injuries.

Seeing Wang Shuo's desperate fighting style, Guliji was like lifting a rock and hitting her own foot, and was quickly defeated!

"You lose!" Wang Shuo pointed his spear at Guliji on the ground and said lightly.
